title: Alix Earle Details Emotional Move Out of Braxton Berrios’ House on ‘Earle Meets World’
summary: Alix Earle reveals that “Earle Meets World” began with her emotional move out of Braxton Berrios’ house and opens up about filming after their breakup.
body_markdown:
[Alix Earle](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/alix-earle) is opening up about just how quickly cameras started capturing the aftermath of her breakup with Braxton Berrios for her new Netflix reality series, *Earle Meets World* .


[Earle Meets World Cast Event Exclusive interview on Hits 1 Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/EarleMeetsWorld-Hits1)


During an exclusive *Earle Meets World* *Cast Event* with[The Morning Mash Up](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/morning-mash-up) on[SiriusXM Hits 1 (Ch. 2)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/siriusxm-hits-1) , Alix revealed that the first scene she filmed for the series involved moving out of her ex-boyfriend’s house.


“First thing we filmed too was I was like moving out of my boyfriend’s house and it was like a really vulnerable — I was like snotty and all over the place,” Alix said.


- **Related:[Alix Earle Opens Up to Howard Stern About Her Success and More](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/alix-earle-breast-implants-howard-stern)**


“I’m like in the room with like 12 people staring at me like this and I’m like okay amazing,” Alix added.


The *Earle Meets World* *Cast Event* also included Thomas “TJ” Earle, Thomas Earle, Ashley Dupré, Izabel Earle, Penelope Earle, Ashtin Earle, Alisa Earle, and Todd Galski.


Stream the entire *Earle Meets World* *Cast Event* with Alix Earle and her family on SiriusXM Hits 1 and the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/EarleMeetsWorld-Hits1) . Plus, watch a clip from it above now.


### Alix Earle Says Braxton Berrios Appears Throughout ‘Earle Meets World’


Although Earle and Berrios have since split, she confirmed that he appears in the Netflix series and said she made an effort to keep him informed about what viewers will see.


“He does know and I wanted to like make him aware of everything,” Alix said.


Alix joked about Berrios’ role in the season before summing up her own experience filming the breakup aftermath.


“All I did was cry the whole season,” Alix said. “But um, yeah, he knows. We talk about how great he is.”


### Alix Earle on Giving Up Creative Control


The series also required Alix to adjust to something very different from posting on social media: giving other people control over how her life would ultimately be presented to viewers.


“It’s scary,” Alix said. “Letting go of that control was something that was tough for me in the beginning.”


Alix said the family ultimately decided to embrace the process despite sharing moments she might otherwise have kept private.


“There were so many moments where I’m like, ‘Oh gosh, this is like a really vulnerable moment for me, or something I’m not sure if I want to share,’” Alix said.
